title: Life Plan Coordination Note — Annual Increase Ceilings for Independent Living Residents Holding an Entrance Fee Agreement
content:
At the Life Plan campuses, an Independent Living Residency Agreement may sit beside an Entrance Fee Agreement. The contract ceiling percentage of an annual increase of the independent living monthly service fee follows the resident's Larkspur contract.

## The rule

- A resident whose **occupied** Entrance Fee Agreement names **this residency** under a **lifecare plan** has a contract ceiling of **4.0 percent**.
- A resident whose **occupied** Entrance Fee Agreement names **this residency** under a **fee-for-service plan** has a contract ceiling of **6.0 percent**.
- Any other resident has the contractual ceiling written into the Independent Living Residency Agreement for the apartment type, with no Entrance Fee Agreement ceiling.

## The records that decide it

Three facts are read from the customer's Entrance Fee Agreement record: its status (occupied or not), the plan's contract type (lifecare or fee-for-service), and the independent living residency the agreement names.

| Entrance Fee Agreement status | Names this independent living residency | Plan contract type | Contract ceiling percentage |
|---|---|---|---|
| Occupied | Yes | Lifecare | 4.0 percent |
| Occupied | Yes | Fee-for-service | 6.0 percent |
| Occupied | No — names another residency or none | Either | The Independent Living Residency Agreement's own contractual ceiling |
| Not occupied (for example reserved), or no Entrance Fee Agreement | — | — | The Independent Living Residency Agreement's own contractual ceiling |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A Larkspur at Harbor View couple holds an occupied Entrance Fee Agreement under a lifecare plan, and the agreement names the independent living residency they occupy: the contract ceiling is 4.0 percent.
- A resident's occupied Entrance Fee Agreement under a fee-for-service plan names the residency of the apartment the resident occupies: the contract ceiling is 6.0 percent.
- A resident holds only a rental Independent Living Residency Agreement: there is no Entrance Fee Agreement ceiling, and the residency agreement's own contractual ceiling stands.

The contract ceiling percentage is a percentage of the fee in effect immediately before the increase.
